SKILL.md opens: 'This file is a skill sheet an agent can read to know which upstream tool to call for a given user request' and its core content is a two-column table headed 'User says | Agent runs' ('"B站搜一下 AI 教程" | `bili search`'), i.e. work for someone else to perform later. README.md concedes the capability itself was never built: 'The upstream project installs itself over the network by having an agent fetch and execute `docs/install.md`. That step is out of reach here on purpose', leaving only 'the *routing knowledge* the README already states'. Nothing here gives an agent eyes on the internet; it is a briefing telling a further agent and the user what to do to get them.
